title: Skull and Snake
coreRelationships: The glossy, dark skull contrasts sharply with the matte, textured white background.
The vibrant, almost neon green of the snake provides a strong color accent against the dark skull and monochrome background.
The organic, scaled texture of the snake contrasts with the smooth, metallic sheen of the skull.
The coiled posture of the snake creates a sense of tension and movement around the static skull.
reuseFormula: Generate a 3D render of a dark, glossy, stylized skull (e.g., bird or dragon-like) with a vibrant green, scaled snake coiled around it. Place this against a high-contrast, distressed black and white grunge background. Add a small, black, all-caps sans-serif text block in the bottom right corner, enclosed in a black rectangle.
